note: Tahoe National Forest campground on Highway 89 between Truckee and Tahoe City, beside the Truckee River. The RV sites sit under pines near the highway; the river-edge sites are walk-in tent sites. Limited turnaround space restricts RVs to 24 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits with little to spare. Fly-fishing, swimming and tubing on the river; bears frequent the area. --Claude
summary: rec.gov details/rates/catalog and FS page read. $20, extra vehicle $10, 14-night max, May 21-Oct 11. 13 reservable RV sites; turnaround limits RVs to 24 ft. Riverview -> not waterfront (river ~20-25 m wide, RV sites 75-90 m back under canopy behind walk-in tent sites).

Only the walk-in tent sites 'overlook the Truckee River' (FS).
